sentences.text:
Author: Rakesh Thapliyal
Bench: Rakesh Thapliyal
 Office Notes,
Sl. Date reports,
No. orders or Court'S Or Judge'S Order

S  proceedings  or directions  and  Registrar's  order with  Signatures  C482 No. 2171 of 2023  Hon'ble Rakesh Thapliyal, J.
1. Ms. Sadaf, learned counsel for the applicants.
2.

By the instant C482 petition, the applicants are challenging the proceedings of Criminal Complaint Case No. 441 of 2023, which pertains to the offences punishable under Sections 323, 504 and 498A IPC read with Section 3/4 of the Dowry Prohibition Act pending in the court of Judicial Magistrate, Rudraprayag, District Rudraprayag.

3. The learned counsel for the applicants submits that the allegations, as alleged in the complaint,
are not true.
In fact, the relations of the respondent with her husband are very cordial.
The learned counsel further submits that there is no specific allegation against the present applicants, and counseling is going on before the trial court and at the most it is a matrimonial dispute.
Apart from this, the learned counsel for the applicants further submits that applicant no. 1 is mother-in- law and applicant no. 2 is father-in-law of the respondent/complainant.
Lastly, it is submitted that initiation of this proceedings against the present applicants is totally an abuse of process of law.
It is also pleaded in para 25 that since the counseling is going on, there are ample chances of compromise between them.
The learned counsel for the applicants shall take steps to serve the respondent by registered post as well as by electronic mode within seven working days.

Having heard learned counsel for the applicants, as an interim measure, further proceedings of Criminal Complaint Case No. 441 of 2023, for the offences punishable under Sections 323, 504 and 498A IPC read with Section 3/4 of the Dowry Prohibition Act pending in the court of Judicial C482/2171/2023 on 8 November, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/55009530/
1 Magistrate, Rudraprayag, District Rudraprayag, is kept in abeyance.
However, the counseling which is going on, as mentioned in para 25, may continue.
8. Stay application 1 of 2023 stands disposed of.

(Rakesh Thapliyal, J.) 08.11.2023 Parul C482/2171/2023 on 8 November, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/55009530/
2
